name: @causeway-services/mud
description: mud.561.group -- the 561 Group's MUD/graphical-MMO directory, a JSON-parameterized keyword filter over the same play.561.group catalog platform (never a forked copy): live listings, per-game pages, honest web-play links. Player chat network is explicitly out of scope for this pass.

scripts.check: for f in serve.mjs js/*.mjs build.mjs scripts/*.mjs test/*.test.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
